decision: Keep component-wise gain selection; select a finite actual-mean coordinate zero-gain fallback for a subsequent learner revision.
production_integration: not_applied; frozen src/scm_online.c and estimator model/checkpoint version 2 remain unchanged
rule: Compute t=lambda*gain and the actual rounded proposed mean in the production operation order.
Reject nonfinite results as before. If the proposed mean is finite but outside its coordinate support, set t=0 and lambda=0 and retain the committed predicted coordinate.
Store final t and compute masks/extrema from that selection; use exactly the same t in the mean and full Joseph covariance.
Retain the all-zero-gain byte-preservation path, prediction-before-correction transaction and exactly-once ledgers.
why: Rounded feasibility division and ineffective relative backoff admit a one-subnormal-unit negative trial. A coordinate-only fallback provides a finite support-preserving choice without suppressing other coordinates or clipping mean independently of covariance.
bounded_work: One actual-mean feasibility branch per coordinate; no retries, search, variance floor, process noise, forgetting or observation reuse.

cost.capture_scope: fixture only; two named records may coexist (160 bytes). No full fixture-process or target-stack claim.

historical_17_rejections.missing_datum: One actual rejected step with stage, coordinate/column, input, predicted mean/factor and gain/innovation operands. Query endpoints do not contain these.

before_another_primary: Freeze a concrete bounded learner/nonlinear-evidence mechanism addressing biased local uncertainty and one discriminating test. Numerical repair and reporting policy alone do not qualify accuracy or permit campaign escalation.
